name: paytmresolve-ai
description: PaytmResolve AI — AI Payment Operations Teammate. Unified production entry point: builds the frontend, then serves it from the same Express process that hosts the API, so the whole app deploys as a single Node service (Render, Railway, or any standard Node host).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
